 NEW YORK – The UFC will stage a massive UFC 335 and UFC 336 press conference on Friday with eight fighters from the two cards set to take the stage.
 In attendance to answer questions for the media will be UFC 335 headliners Charles Oliveira and Diego Lopes, who meet for the BMF belt, as well as heavyweight co-headliners Alex Pereira and Sergei Pavlovich. Additionally, the UFC 336 title bouts of Joshua Van vs. Manel Kape and Carlos Prates vs. Michael Morales will be on hand.
 UFC 335 takes place Dec. 12 at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. UFC 336 is scheduled for Jan. 30 at Scotiabank Arena in Toronto. Both events stream entirely on Paramount+.
 The kick-off press conference with the four matchups begins at 4:30 p.m. ET from Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, and MMA Junkie will be on-site with a live stream in the video above.
 This article originally appeared on MMA Junkie: Video: UFC 335 & UFC 336 press conference live stream
 Reporting by Mike Bohn and Jeronimo Guerra, MMA Junkie / MMA Junkie
